integral” of f, while f(x)dx is called, by way of contrast, a “definite integral.”
This suggestive notation works out quite well in practice, but it is important not to
be led astray. At the risk ofboring you, the following fact is emphasized once again:
the integral f(x)dx is not defined as “F(b) — F(a), where F is an indefinite
